notes.title: UPDATE: [ANOMALY TAPES]: Beyond Reality is offically FREE
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everyone,
[/p][p]Just a quick follow-up to my last post \[ANOMALY TAPES]: Beyond Reality is now officially Free to Play.
[/p][p]As I mentioned earlier, this change was made because I unfortunately lost access to the project files, which means I’m no longer able to update or patch the game. Given that, I didn’t feel comfortable continuing to charge for something I can’t support properly.
[/p][p]I want to say again how much I appreciate all the love and support this game has received. This was the first game I ever published, putting it out there was a huge step for me, and seeing people play it, talk about it, and even recommend it has meant more than I can explain. It’s given me the motivation to keep creating.[/p][p]I also want to respond to a comment from the previous announcement. Someone mentioned that they felt the game was still worth charging for, even if the price was lowered instead of going free. Not only did you say that without any frustration, but you said it [i]because[/i] of the game’s quality. That really meant a lot to me, and it reminded me that this is something I should be proud of.[/p][p]That said, once a game is set to Free to Play on Steam, that change is permanent — so I won’t be able to adjust the price back, even if I wanted to.[/p][p]If you’re looking for more context, the previous announcement goes into more detail. This post was just to confirm the change and to thank you all again for supporting the project.
[/p][p]Kind regards,
PANIX[/p]

notes.title: Important Update: [ANOMALY TAPES]: Beyond Reality is Going Free Soon
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]I just wanted to give you all a quick update about [i]\[ANOMALY TAPES]: Beyond Reality[/i].[/p][p][/p][p]I’ve submitted the request to Steam to make the game free to play. That change should go live in the next few days, once it’s been processed. I’ll post a quick update here once it’s official.[/p][p][/p][p]Now, I want to take a moment to speak directly to those of you who bought the game. This decision wasn’t made lightly, The truth is, I lost the source files after a full PC reset, and despite having backups, they were either corrupted or from an earlier, incomplete version of the game. Without access to the final build, I’m no longer able to update or fix anything in the game.[/p][p][/p][p]Because of that, I don’t feel right continuing to charge for something I can’t support anymore, but I also worried a lot about how this change might feel to those of you who did pay for it. That’s been the hardest part of making this decision.[/p][p][/p][p]So to everyone who supported the game by buying it, thank you, seriously. You made it possible for this game to exist in the first place. The fact that people enjoyed it and gave it a shot, especially as my first solo project, means the world to me. Everyone who streamed the game, left a review whether it was on the store page, the community page or in a video, shared their thoughts or even just decided to pick it up and give it a go. Again, Thank you. I can't express how grateful I am for this experience.[/p][p][/p][p]What really blows me away is the refund rate, just 7.4%. For a short indie horror game, especially one with a restart-on-death mechanic that frustrated some people, that’s honestly incredible. To me, that says most of you who bought the game really did enjoy it. And that means more than I can say.[/p][p][/p][p]If you have stories or memories from playing, I’d love to hear about them. Feel free to drop them in the comments or discussions. I’ll be around, reading.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks again to everyone who’s been part of this journey. Even though this chapter is closing, working on this game taught me a lot and made me want to keep creating. I'll still be around and trying to keep up to date with what's happening within the community.[/p][p][/p][p]- PANIX[/p]

notes.title: Tape 2 Patch
notes.notes:
I have noticed that Tape 2 has been unforgiving in ways that were not intended. Because of this, I have fixed the following:

[olist]
[*] [b]**The entity will continuously make noise while it’s behind you**[/b]
Before, the entity would make noise periodically as soon as it spawns behind you. Now the entity will make continuous noise while behind you so that there is no confusion on if the entity is still there or not.

[*] [b]**Reduced player's sight angle**[/b]
This should allow for players to have a slight view of the entity before it attacks. Before, even having the entity slightly on screen would end with a game over. This patch allows a bit more of a forgiving sight radius so that you can notice the entity in the corner of your eye and look away.

[*] [b]**Longer time before the entity attacks if it's not able to spawn**[/b]
Having the entity attack if your back was against a wall was added to prevent people from completing the level by running with their back against the walls. After noticing how this was affecting players, I have increased the amount of time you can have your back against a wall when it tries to spawn.
[/olist]

Thank you to everyone who has tried out the Demo so far!
